title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing, especially around kelvin and the COP.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a COP-versus-supply-temperature graph to the Session 1 app
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 app plots the COP against the outdoor temperature only, but the supply temperature has an equally large effect.

## Context
Students ask why radiators are worse than floor heating for a heat pump.

## Expected outcome
A third view in the Session 1 app with COP on the vertical axis and supply temperature on the horizontal axis, with labelled axes and units.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Axes labelled with units
- [ ] The dot follows the sliders

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: weather-compensated supply temperature
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`. The shipped simulation uses one fixed supply temperature all winter.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add an on/off thermostat with a dead band and minimum run time
body:
## Problem
Session 3 uses a perfect modulating thermostat; fixed-speed machines cycle on and off.

## Context
Roadmap milestone 2.

## Expected outcome
A lesson and app that count starts per day for different dead bands and show the comfort trade-off.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Starts per day reported for at least three dead bands
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: a winter week with night setback and a two-node house
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows a heat pump and a heater side by side over a cold week; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Heat pump week cost below 40 percent of the heater
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
